name: Cluster
description: Unsupervised clustering of one or more numeric columns with k-means++ (default), DBSCAN or agglomerative hierarchical clustering (Ward, complete or average linkage). Appends the cluster label (Int64; -1 is DBSCAN noise) and the per-row silhouette (Float64, NULL for noise and when fewer than two clusters exist). Features are optionally z-score standardized first.

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: Numeric feature columns the clusters are computed on.

method.title: Method
method.description: kmeans uses k-means++ seeding and Lloyd iterations, dbscan finds density-connected clusters and marks noise with -1, hierarchical merges clusters with the selected linkage.

k.title: Clusters
k.description: Requested number of clusters for kmeans and hierarchical; must not exceed the number of complete rows. Ignored by dbscan.

standardize.title: Standardize
standardize.description: Z-score every feature before clustering; a constant column becomes zero.

seed.title: Random seed
seed.description: Seed of the k-means++ initialization; the same seed and input give the same clusters.

max_iterations.title: Maximum iterations
max_iterations.description: Upper bound on k-means Lloyd iterations; positive.

eps.title: DBSCAN radius
eps.description: Neighbourhood radius in the (optionally standardized) feature space; positive. Used by dbscan only.

min_points.title: DBSCAN minimum points
min_points.description: Minimum neighbourhood size (including the point itself) for a core point; positive. Used by dbscan only.

linkage.title: Linkage
linkage.description: Agglomeration rule for hierarchical clustering: ward minimizes the within-cluster variance increase, complete uses the farthest pair, average the mean distance.

max_rows.title: Maximum rows
max_rows.description: Clustering is computed in memory and supports at most this many complete rows; a larger input is an error with a hint to raise the cap or pre-filter. Hierarchical clustering is additionally capped at 1000 rows.
